name: Arpst DebugSandbox — Diagnostics & Session Sandbox
author: ARPRO Studio

sections.description:
Test plugins, switch themes, and fix site errors without breaking your live website for visitors.

When something goes wrong on a WordPress site, the usual advice is to turn off your plugins and switch to a default theme to find the cause. Doing that on a live website can break your layout or online store for everyone visiting your site. Arpst DebugSandbox lets you open a private test session inside your own browser so you can turn plugins on or off, try another theme, and test changes safely while regular visitors continue seeing your normal website. As soon as you exit the test session, every temporary change resets back to normal automatically.

You also get everyday troubleshooting tools right inside your WordPress dashboard (no FTP or server access needed): read live PHP, database, and email error logs, record intermittent bugs in the background, check if core WordPress files were altered, test whether your site is sending emails properly, and copy a safe server summary to share with support teams.

What You Can Do With Arpst DebugSandbox (100% Free)

  • 1. Find Plugin & Theme Conflicts Privately (Session Sandbox):
    Start a private troubleshooting session that only runs in your browser. Disable plugins one by one (or use Bulk Deactivate on the Plugins screen), switch themes, or test changes to posts, pages, menus, comments, and plugin settings. Your live visitors never see what you are testing, and clicking Exit Sandbox automatically restores your test edits.

  • 2. Read Error Logs Inside WP-Admin (No FTP Needed):
    View PHP errors, warnings, failed API/webhook requests, failed email attempts, and database SQL errors in real time right from the Debug Log Inspector tab. Filter entries by plugin or severity to spot the exact culprit fast. Want to catch a bug that happens randomly while you are away? Turn on the Background Flight Recorder (24-Hour Timed mode or Continuous 5 MB Auto-Rotate mode) and review the recorded log later. All logs are stored privately in wp-content/uploads/arpst-debugsandbox/ with .htaccess protection.

  • 3. Check WordPress Core Files:
    Verify your wp-admin/ and wp-includes/ files against official WordPress.org checksums in one click to spot modified, corrupted, or unexpected files.

  • 4. Test Outgoing WordPress Emails (wp_mail()):
    Quickly find out why contact forms, password resets, or order notifications are not arriving. Send a real test email from your dashboard to verify delivery and measure response speed in milliseconds. Working on a local test site without an SMTP server? The built-in Localhost Mail Catcher lets you preview the captured email headers and body anyway.

  • 5. Inspect .htaccess, robots.txt & Fix 404 Errors:
    Check your permalink rewrite rules and search crawler settings in one screen, and flush WordPress permalinks in one click when pages show 404 errors.

  • 6. Share Safe Server Info With Support Teams:
    Export a clean Markdown or JSON summary of your WordPress, PHP, database, theme, and active plugin versions in one click. Your domain name, email addresses, IP addresses, and server folder paths are automatically removed before copying so you can paste safely in support forums or GitHub issues.

  • 7. Easy Upgrade From Legacy Health Check:
    Previously used the classic Health Check & Troubleshooting plugin? Import your saved settings in one click and remove outdated Must-Use files left behind.

Optional Arpst DebugSandbox Pro Companion (Separate Add-On)

Every core feature listed above (Session Sandbox with automatic rollback, Background Flight Recorder in both 24-Hour and 5 MB continuous modes, Core File Checker, Email Tester, and Safe Server Exporter) is 100% free and unlocked in this plugin.

If you run a busy website or manage client sites and want automated 24/7 crash protection, you can pair this plugin with the separate Arpst DebugSandbox Pro add-on from ARPRO Studio:

  • 24/7 Crash Auto-Recovery: Automatically catches fatal PHP crashes (“White Screen of Death”) and disables only the crashing plugin so your live site stays online.
  • Temporary Magic Debug Links: Create a time-limited link (1, 4, or 24 hours) that lets a developer or support team troubleshoot inside an isolated Sandbox session without you ever sharing your WP-Admin password.
  • Instant Crash Alerts: Receive immediate notifications by Email, Telegram, Discord, or Slack whenever a fatal crash occurs.
  • Live Session Monitor & Audit Reports: Monitor active Sandbox sessions across your team, close sessions remotely, and download full .log session reports.

Credits & License

Built and maintained by ARPRO Studio. Originally forked from Health Check & Troubleshooting and modernized for WordPress 6.0 through 7.1+ and PHP 7.4 through 8.5. Distributed under the GPLv2+ license without warranty; keeping regular site backups before troubleshooting is always recommended.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services only when an administrator explicitly clicks the corresponding diagnostic or feedback button in WP-Admin. It never tracks front-end visitors and never sends automatic background requests on page load.

  1. WordPress.org Core Checksums API (https://api.wordpress.org/core/checksums/1.0/)

    • What it is used for: Verifies local WordPress core files against official WordPress.org MD5 checksums in Tab 3 (“Integrity, Mail & Blueprint”).
    • What data is sent and when: Sends your current WordPress version number and locale (for example, en_US) only when an administrator clicks the “Run Official WordPress.org Checksum Scan Now” button.
    • Terms & Privacy: WordPress.org Privacy Policy.

  2. ARPRO Studio Feedback & Support Endpoint (https://arprostudio.com/wp-json/ar-license/v1/feedback)

    • What it is used for: Allows administrators to voluntarily send a feature suggestion or bug report directly to the developer from Tab 5 (“Roadmap & Feedback”).
    • What data is sent and when: Sent only when an administrator fills out the feedback form in Tab 5, ticks the explicit opt-in consent checkbox, and clicks submit. Transmits the submitted subject, message, reply-to email address, site URL, and (if the optional telemetry box is checked) basic WordPress, PHP, and database version strings.
    • Service Provider: ARPRO Studio (https://arprostudio.com).
    • Terms of Service: https://arprostudio.com/terms-of-service/
    • Privacy Policy: https://arprostudio.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. In your WordPress admin dashboard, navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Arpst DebugSandbox.
  3. Click Install Now, and then click Activate.
  4. Click Arpst Sandbox in the left-hand WP-Admin sidebar to open the dashboard.

Manual Installation via .zip Upload

  1. Download arpst-debugsandbox.zip from WordPress.org or arprostudio.com.
  2. In your WordPress admin dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin (or extract the arpst-debugsandbox folder to /wp-content/plugins/).
  3. Activate Arpst DebugSandbox through the Plugins screen.
  4. Open Arpst Sandbox in the WP-Admin sidebar to launch an isolated troubleshooting session, inspect your logs, or run core integrity checks.
sections.faq:
Does Arpst DebugSandbox affect my live website visitors while I am troubleshooting?

No. Sandbox mode isolates your changes to a private cookie inside your own browser. Regular visitors without that cookie continue to see your normal active plugins, theme, and live content at all times.

What happens if I deactivate all plugins, change settings, or edit/trash a post while inside the Sandbox?

Everything done inside the Sandbox stays strictly isolated to your Sandbox session. Even if you select all plugins on the Plugins screen and click Deactivate, modify site settings, or create/edit/trash test posts, pages, categories, or comments, live visitors never see those changes and 100% of your session changes are automatically rolled back the moment you click Exit Sandbox.

Where are diagnostic and flight recorder logs stored?

All diagnostic logs written by this plugin are stored inside a protected folder in your WordPress uploads directory (wp-content/uploads/arpst-debugsandbox/) guarded by .htaccess, index.php, and a randomized filename hash. Clearing the log inside a Sandbox session only clears your virtual session view and never erases your live log file on disk.

Does this plugin track front-end visitors or slow down my front end?

No. Arpst DebugSandbox contains zero front-end tracking scripts, analytics beacons, or advertisements, and adds zero overhead for normal website visitors.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release by ARPRO Studio (https://arprostudio.com).
  • Added browser-isolated Session Sandbox with full plugin, theme, content, taxonomy, comment, and in-session option virtualization and automatic rollback.
  • Added wp-admin/plugins.php bulk action interceptor and Sandbox host lock protection so bulk plugin deactivation inside a Sandbox never affects the live site.
  • Added 1-click legacy Health Check & Troubleshooting migrator and cleanup.
  • Added Real-Time Diagnostic Log Terminal and Unattended Background Debug Flight Recorder (24-Hour Timed and Continuous 5 MB Auto-Rotate modes in protected uploads directory).
  • Added WordPress.org Core File Integrity Checksum Scanner, wp_mail() delivery latency tester with Localhost Mail Catcher, .htaccess / robots.txt inspector, and 1-click Anonymized Server Blueprint Exporter (Markdown & JSON).
